# DIGI BIZ OS

> DIGI BIZ OS is a voice-first AI agentic business operating system for Windows 10 and 11, built by Digiformation Ltd. You speak; it plans and executes real work on your machine — documents, files, research, coding, reporting and scheduled automation.

Key facts:
- Category: AI desktop assistant / AI business operating system (a practical "JARVIS-style" assistant).
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11 today. macOS, Linux and a mobile companion are in development.
- Capabilities: 500+ AI skills, 150+ mixed tools, multi-agent delegation, workflows, scheduled jobs, document suite, coding workspace, model routing, custom memories.
- Licensing: one-time payment, no subscription. Lifetime Access £50, Source Code Licence £199, Custom Build £299.
- Contact: info@digiformation.co.uk, WhatsApp +92 316 446 7464.
